text:
```yaml
name: Index Translations
on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  index-translations:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .

      - name: Run translation indexing
        run: |
          python -c "
          import alfanous
          count = alfanous.index_translations('src/alfanous/configs/')
          print(f'Indexed {count} translations')
          "

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          python -m pytest src/tests/test_index_api.py -v

      - name: Verify translations.json exists
        run: |
          ls -la src/alfanous/configs/translations.json

      - name: Commit changes
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          message: "Update translations.json with indexed translations"
          add: "src/alfanous/configs/translations.json"
```
